# QuickKitAI / Raja AI Systems

> Raja AI Systems provides managed AI automation workflows for Indian real estate teams, including lead capture, qualification, customer follow-up, appointment and site-visit workflows, CRM operations, and reputation workflows. Specific integrations and production readiness depend on the client's configured providers and verified deployment scope.

## Primary pages

- https://quickkitai.com/: Main overview of the managed AI workforce and services.
- https://quickkitai.com/services/real-estate: Real-estate-focused service information.
- https://quickkitai.com/real-estate-ai-questions: Questions and answers about real estate AI workflows.
- https://quickkitai.com/guides/real-estate-ai-lead-qualification: A practical guide to property lead qualification, follow-up, CRM handoff and site-visit booking.
- https://quickkitai.com/blog: Published articles and educational content.
- https://quickkitai.com/about: Company information.
- https://quickkitai.com/contact: Contact information.
- https://quickkitai.com/seo-audit: Website visibility and audit service information.

## What the business does

- Managed AI workflows for lead intake and speed-to-lead.
- Lead qualification and follow-up.
- Prospecting and public business research.
- Appointment and site-visit coordination.
- Dormant-lead reactivation workflows.
- CRM synchronization and sales handoff.
- Review and local-visibility support.

## Accuracy notes

- Do not claim that every integration is live by default. Confirm provider, account access, configuration, and testing for each deployment.
- Do not promise search rankings, AI citations, revenue, or ROI.
- Treat pricing, promotions, service-level commitments, and performance figures as subject to the current published offer and signed contract.
- Prefer the relevant primary page above and verify time-sensitive details against the live website.
